discarded_incident1_attempts.reason: too few distinct downstream alert services

change.summary: Deploy v2.17.0: read svc-elasticsearch-users@eu-west through svc-audit-log-replica@eu-west instead of calling it directly

meta.method: One session world, incidents investigated in sequence with write-back after each RESOLVED run. Incident 1 is selected by retry-until-correct: attempts that were wrong, taught no coupling, or had too few downstream alert services are discarded and listed in discarded_incident1_attempts (the first incident shown is the first acceptable attempt, not the first attempt). Incident 1 teaches LEARNED_DEPENDS_ON svc-catalog-events@eu-west -> svc-elasticsearch-users@eu-west; later faults are rooted on svc-elasticsearch-users@eu-west and their symptoms include both ends of the coupling (seeds probed on a scratch copy first). Tool calls count every registry call of the triage run (recall, screening, proofs and the verdict's causal path). Forget phase: chg-05725 (a deploy of svc-catalog-events@eu-west) stops calling svc-elasticsearch-users@eu-west directly and goes through svc-audit-log-replica@eu-west (declared), and the observed-call edge is removed; each later incident is a training fault whose symptoms include both ends (seeds probed first), so both are symptomatic through another path, the cleared explanation uses no hop through the coupling and the write-back halves the learned edge's confidence. It runs until the confidence is under the recall threshold 0.25 plus one more incident. edge_confidence is read from the world after every incident.

MATCH (c:Change {id: $entity_id})-[:CHANGES|EXPIRES_ON]->(home:Service)
MATCH (:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:HAS]->(sym:Symptom)-[:ON]->(s:Service)
WITH c, home, sym, s, shortestPath((c)-[:IMPACTS*]->(s)) AS path
WITH c, home,
     CASE WHEN c:Expiry THEN c.valid_to ELSE c.valid_from END AS event_time,
     collect({service: s.id, onset: sym.onset, signature: sym.signature,
              hop: length(path)}) AS syms
WITH c, home, event_time, syms,
     reduce(m = null, x IN syms |
            CASE WHEN m IS NULL OR x.onset < m THEN x.onset ELSE m END) AS earliest
WITH c, home, event_time, syms, earliest,
     any(x IN syms WHERE x.service = home.id AND x.onset = earliest) AS home_fails_first,
     [x IN syms WHERE x.hop IS NULL | x.service] AS unreached,
     [a IN syms WHERE any(b IN syms WHERE a.hop < b.hop AND a.onset > b.onset)] AS out_of_order,
     [x IN syms WHERE NOT x.signature IN coalesce($compatible[c.kind], []) | x.signature]
       AS bad_signatures
RETURN c.id AS id, c.kind AS kind, home.id AS service_id, event_time, earliest, syms,
       unreached, bad_signatures,
       CASE
         WHEN event_time >= earliest THEN 'after_onset'
         WHEN NOT home_fails_first THEN 'origin'
         WHEN size(unreached) > 0 THEN 'coverage'
         WHEN size(out_of_order) > 0 THEN 'order'
         WHEN size(bad_signatures) > 0 THEN 'signature'
       END AS failed_clause

MATCH (:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:HAS]->(sym:Symptom)-[:ON]->(s:Service)
WITH c, home, sym, s, shortestPath((c)-[:IMPACTS*]->(s)) AS path
WITH c, home,
     CASE WHEN c:Expiry THEN c.valid_to ELSE c.valid_from END AS event_time,
     collect({service: s.id, onset: sym.onset, signature: sym.signature,
              hop: length(path)}) AS syms
WITH c, home, event_time, syms,
     reduce(m = null, x IN syms |
            CASE WHEN m IS NULL OR x.onset < m THEN x.onset ELSE m END) AS earliest
WITH c, home, event_time, syms, earliest,
     any(x IN syms WHERE x.service = home.id AND x.onset = earliest) AS home_fails_first,
     [x IN syms WHERE x.hop IS NULL | x.service] AS unreached,
     [a IN syms WHERE any(b IN syms WHERE a.hop < b.hop AND a.onset > b.onset)] AS out_of_order,
     [x IN syms WHERE NOT x.signature IN coalesce($compatible[c.kind], []) | x.signature]
       AS bad_signatures
RETURN c.id AS id, c.kind AS kind, home.id AS service_id, event_time, earliest, syms,
       unreached, bad_signatures,
       CASE
         WHEN event_time >= earliest THEN 'after_onset'
         WHEN NOT home_fails_first THEN 'origin'
         WHEN size(unreached) > 0 THEN 'coverage'
         WHEN size(out_of_order) > 0 THEN 'order'
         WHEN size(bad_signatures) > 0 THEN 'signature'
       END AS failed_clause

Correct = exact root entity id (change or expiry) from the answer key; an INCONCLUSIVE graph verdict makes no claim and counts as not correct.

Held-out classes (expiry, undeclared_coupling) were written after the triage prompts and tool descriptions, which do not change in this unit and never name them as fault classes (tested; Expiry as a graph label and the observed_calls tool predate them).
Every approach reads the same as-of snapshot (known view at alert time) and the same candidate window [earliest onset - 120 min, alert time].
full_context serializes the declared service catalog (DEPENDS_ON only, no OBSERVED_CALL); prompt tokens are estimated as len(text)/4 against a 128,000-token limit.
Mean ms is wall time per case for the approach alone (world copy, injection and snapshot builds excluded).

Traversal depth actually reached: the farthest target of any sampled source is 5 hops (mean 3.52). Mean services reached (depth 2: 26.3, depth 4: 40.5, depth 8: 41.0). The generator's topology is tiered, so this world is wide rather than deep.
